quotes.quote: Dockworkers at the Beryl Port container terminal began a strike on Tuesday after wage talks collapsed.
The terminal suspended all container operations on Tuesday, the port authority said.
The union and the port authority are expected to resume talks on Thursday.
A strike by dockworkers at the Beryl Port container terminal began on Tuesday after wage negotiations broke down.
Two of the terminal's four berths continued handling containers on Tuesday, according to the port authority's operations log.
Both sides are expected to return to the negotiating table on Thursday.
